entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
For the Respondent/s : Mr.Rina Sinha  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ARVIND SINGH CHANDEL  ORAL ORDER 5 09-08-2024 Heard both sides.

2. At the time of argument, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that initially a complaint case registered under Section 498A of IPC had been preferred by the wife of the petitioner (O.P. No.2),
however, it has been dismissed for want of prosecution.

Later on, he further submits that the petitioner had also filed a petition under Section 13 of Hindu Marriage Act for granting divorce from his wife (O.P. No.2) which has also been dismissed for want of prosecution.

3. Looking to the above submission made by the learned counsel, he is directed to place on record both the petition as well as the final order passed by the concerned Patna High Court CR. REV.
No.257 of 2023(5) dt.09-08-2024 court below before this Court.

4. List this petition on 25.09.2024.
(Arvind Singh Chandel , J) krishnakant/-
